Wilshire West Medical Tower, located at 11645 Wilshire Boulevard, is an 11-story medical office building and penthouse with beautiful panoramic views of Los Angeles. Originally built in 1978 and recently renovated in 2019, the building seamlessly combines timeless architecture with contemporary design to support today’s medical professionals and elevate their practices. 
  
The in-house leasing team at Wilshire West Medical Tower custom-tailors each lease to meet the specific needs of each tenant and their medical practice. This extremely talented team of architects and contractors works together to deliver state-of-the-art medical suites designed for optimal functionality and patient comfort to suit each individual tenant.
     
Located in the prestigious Brentwood neighborhood of Los Angeles,  Wilshire West Medical Tower is ideally located near Beverly Hills, Century City, Westwood, and Santa Monica, making it a central location servicing a much broader community. For tenants looking to build synergy with neighboring medical professionals, the high-rise towers over leading medical institutions, including UCLA Medical Center, Saint John's Hospital, and Cedars-Sinai Medical Center. This building's location is within walking distance of restaurants and shopping areas. Easy access to the 405 and 10 Freeways reinforces this medical destination's connectivity to the surrounding communities for patients and staff alike. 
       
Move to this modern complex and join a community of skilled medical professionals in a wide range of specialties, a spectacular Brentwood location, and a beautifully remodeled building. Wilshire West Medical Tower is the perfect location for any medical practice to grow. Beginning June 1, 2025, and ending December 31, 2025, a $6 per rentable square foot broker bonus is being offered on new leases.

Among the most well known architects in the United States, Philip Johnson and John Burgee have created distinctive structures in most of this country's major cities. In the design of TC Energy Center, they have struck a synthesis of past and present. Architectural concepts have been borrowed from 17th century Dutch Renaissance architecture and applied in a modern context.

Completed in October of 1983, TC Energy Center is a 56 story office tower located at 700 Louisiana Street in downtown Houston. The building encompasses 1.25 million square feet of office and retail space and is linked to the extensive Downtown Houston tunnel system.

The interior and exterior of the building is sheathed in rough textured Napoleon red granite, quarried in Sweden and finished in Italy. Even the surrounding sidewalks are composed of the same granite used in the building. The lobby is highlighted by an 18 foot high 1914 Seth Thomas clock, of which only 300 were ever built. The entrance from Louisiana Street is an impressive seventy-five foot high, arched granite doorway. The granite stonework soars upward to 102 feet, 10 stories, and is so intricate that specialists from Spain were brought to Houston to install the more than 100 pieces around the arch. This archway continues through the center of the building to a second arched doorway that opens onto Smith Street. As an added feature, three of the lower office tower floors are bisected by the archway and connected by pedestrian bridges.

The office tower is divided by two major set backs into three segments, giving it the appearance of three adjoining buildings. At the largest points it measures 777 feet high and 110 feet wide. The tower has a steeply pitched gabled roofline that is topped off with spires. The sculpted metal obelisks, made from lead and coated copper, raise from every roof level creating a unique silhouette and dramatic coloring. The obelisks may seem small but are actually eight feet tall on the gable ends, with the topmost finials a crowning 12 feet high. In all, the building is topped with 86 obelisks.
Perhaps the most unusual feature of TC Energy Center is the separate banking hall. It stands approximately 125 feet, 12 stories high at the peak, but only contains three inside levels. This dramatic open space is flooded with natural light from the 10 bronze-framed skylights that run the full 250-foot length of the structure.

There are 32 passenger elevators each finished with rare and beautiful wood panels that include Birdseye Maple, Macassar Ebony, Italian Willow, Tamo and Kevazingo.

Parking Ratio: Unreserved spaces beneath the building are $240.00, unreserved spaces at the Alley Theatre Garage are $145.00 and reserved spaces at the Alley Theatre Garage are $190.00

In 2015, this building was awarded LEED certification at the Gold level by the U.S. Green Building Council. Located in the prestigious Theater District, TC Energy Center is a LEED Gold Certified Class AA Office Building with beautiful park views overlooking the new Lynn Wyatt Square for the Performing Arts.

Completed in 1983, Williams Tower is located adjacent to the famous Galleria mixed-use center, which was also developed by Hines. This dramatic 64-story, 1.4 million-square-foot office tower is a product of the award-winning architectural team of Philip Johnson and John Burgee. The tower was designed to provide the major tenant with all the advantages of a private facility while maximizing land value by including additional multi-tenant speculative space. In order to meet the tenant's requirements, the building functions as two buildings stacked one on top of another, each with its separate elevators, lobbies and garages. Additional special features include a soaring 88-foot-high granite arched entry, an adjacent three-acre park with a 64-foot water wall, a helipad and a revolving beacon of light atop its peaked roof. In 2008, Hines REIT assumed ownership of the property. In 2013, the building was sold to Invesco.

Esperson is ideally located at 808 Travis Street and 815 Walker Avenue in the heart of the Houston Central Business District. This Office/Retail Property is comprised of the 27-story Niels Esperson Building and the adjoining 19-story Mellie Esperson Building, comprising 599,107 square feet, plus an attached seven-story Parking Garage. Originally constructed in 1927 and 1941 by Mellie Esperson, The Esperson Buildings are historic landmarks within Houston, representative of Texas’ rich oil history. Crowned by the Niels Esperson Cupola, this icon of Houston’s CBD skyline is strategically situated in the center of the CBD in the Skyline District between the Skyline Corridor and the Main Street Corridor and in close proximity to the Theater District. The Property is linked to the CBD’s amenity base by the pedestrian/retail tunnel system which spans seven miles. The Property’s physical condition, configuration, strong amenity base, and unique design continue to make Esperson attractive to both small and large multi-tenant users, as well as extremely competitive in attracting new tenants versus other top tier office towers in the CBD. The Property features a superior amenity base and benefits from the unique historic atmosphere of the Esperson legacy. The history and design of the Property cannot be replicated within competing CBD office buildings. Since 2014, Esperson has seen $10M+ in capital improvements including upgrades to the ground floor lobbies, tunnel, and common areas. Along with improvements to the property, additional conveniences were added such as the escalator which connects the first-floor Rusk Street Lobby to the Tunnel System.

Attain a highly connected workspace in the Houston metro, enhanced by the immense on-site advantages at 7324 Southwest Freeway of the Arena Place office park.
  
Two Arena Place provides an elegant, upscale experience from the Class A finishes to the efficiency-maximizing amenities. The office is ultra-convenient with an on-site parking garage, keycard access, shipping drop boxes, a medical clinic, a sundry shop, and more so teams can stay on the go. Two Arena Place is owned and operated by Boxer Property, a key advantage as the experienced Texas-based firm has a portfolio of over 150 buildings and is headquartered in the building. The full-service company can address most needs in-house and is constantly making improvements for its tenants.
    
Boxer Property also offers unique on-site flexible space solutions model. Workstyle executive suites are Boxer Property’s signature hybrid of co-working and private offices that provide startups and small business owners the opportunity to rent individual spaces at a fraction of the cost of a traditional office space. There are furnished and unfurnished options, and members benefit from shared amenities like free Wi-Fi, a coffee bar, conference rooms, huddle rooms, and a training room. 
  
Located along Interstate 69, approximately midway between Downtown Houston and Sugar Land, Arena Place ideally balances proximity to key residential zones and professional hubs. Organizations can quickly reach places like Texas Medical Center, Energy Corridor, and IAH Airport for business needs and easily commute home to popular communities such as Missouri City, Sugar Land, and Rosenberg. There are several amenities just outside of the office for the convenience of workers here, too. Adjacent to the building are Wendy’s, Jack in the Box, Pollo Riko, Fung’s Kitchen, a monthly farmers market, and Arena Theatre, for which tenants can get discounted tickets. The PlazAmericas Mall is also under a 15-minute walk away, and the highway access extends tenants’ reach to amenities.

The Lakes on Post Oak consists of three buildings: 3000 Post Oak Boulevard, a 19-story building, 3040 Post Oak Boulevard, a 22-story building, and 3050 Post Oak Boulevard, a 17-story building, which in total constitute 1.2 million square feet. Each building has its own parking garage. A $20 million capital improvement program was completed on the Property in 2005, the scope of which included brand new lobbies and common areas, upgraded restrooms, new elevator lobbies, redesigned elevator cabs, enhanced grounds and roadways, and enriched landscaping.

The Property is located in the heart of Houston' s Galleria/West Loop submarket whose vibrant mix of entertainment, retail and fine dining create an appealing, in-town living experience that continues to attract businesses and new tenants. The Galleria Mall, located adjacent to the Property, features top retailers and restaurants, an impressive ice rink, and two hotels. With its stunning architecture, exceptional store mix and distinctive style of entertainment, The Galleria has established itself as the #1 shopping and tourist destination in Houston with over 24 million annual visitors. The Lakes on Post Oak provides unmatched access to  both U.S. Highway 59 and the 610 West Loop. Supplementing the access to this established location is the Westpark Tollway, which offers direct access to the Property for residents traveling from the West and Southwest areas of Houston.

Located at 14405 Walters Road in Houston, Texas, Northwest Commerce Building offers a professional office environment with a wide range of flexible leasing options. With recently upgraded common areas, a beautifully landscaped exterior, and competitive pricing, this property provides an excellent opportunity for businesses looking to establish themselves in a well-maintained, tenant-focused facility.
   
Northwest Commerce Building features spaces ranging from private executive suites starting at around 200 square feet to full-floor configurations of up to 15,000 square feet, with options to combine floors for larger requirements. Many spaces are move-in ready, and whitebox options allow for customization. Tenants benefit from on-site property management, a fully renovated tenant center, an outdoor patio area, and an on-site deli. Ample garage parking and amenities like FedEx mail drop boxes add to the building’s convenience. 
    
Positioned just off FM 1960 near Interstate 45 and Highway 249, 14405 Walters Road is a highly commutable address and puts tenants close to major hubs like Methodist Willowbrook Hospital and Bush Intercontinental Airport and talent-filled communities like Spring. It is within walking distance of major retailers like Aldi, Home Depot, and Walmart, as well as a variety of restaurants. With annual rental rates of approximately $10 per square foot lower than the Houston market average, Northwest Commerce Building offers excellent value in a less congested area that remains accessible to Houston's well-educated workforce. Whether for a small business or an established organization, Northwest Commerce Building is an ideal location to thrive in Houston.

Century Plaza Towers is the landmark, 2.3 million square foot office project anchoring the eastern edge of Century Park--the premier office, dining and community-gathering destination in the heart of Century City, California. Century Plaza Towers is a Class “A” office project comprised of two 44-story office buildings and has one of the nation’s most prestigious tenant rosters, including some of America’s leading innovators in professional service industries like Entertainment, Law, Finance and Investment, New Technology and Communications. 

Century Plaza Towers soars above four acres of masterfully landscaped gardens, groves of canopy trees and peaceful passageways, offering tenants, visitors and guests a comprehensive array of amenities. These include destination dining, such as the acclaimed Craft Los Angeles, and a Promenade of Cafes, including The Stand, Piknic, Habanero Grill, Cuvee and The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf®. 

Inside Century Plaza Towers, elegantly designed office space offers accommodations for over 40 perimeter private offices. With floor plates averaging 25,700 SF and an impressive 38 feet from the window line to core wall, prestigious corner offices provide panoramic views from city to sea. In addition, a sophisticated floor-to-ceiling Pilkington Glass curtain wall with a mullion-less system has transformed the building lobbies, creating spectacular views from their entrances and valet through to the lushly landscaped centerpiece park. These expansive new lobbies also offer improved pedestrian flow and access to the Towers across contemporary black Mesabi granite that appeals to tenants, visitors and guests alike.

Outside, attractive and sophisticated lithocrete and river rock now spans the entire outdoor plaza around the Towers, flowing up to the base of the Pilkington Glass curtain wall to create a wonderful synergy with the park. A 6-level subterranean parking garage offers convenient access from all major streets. Executive and Visitor Valet are always available, as well as short term parking for bank customers and couriers. Upon entrance, security consoles have been expanded to provide more efficient visitor access management and enhance pedestrian flow. 

Century Plaza Towers is strategically situated for easy access to key Southern California businesses and residential destinations like Beverly Hills, Bel Air, Westwood and Santa Monica.  Downtown LA, Hollywood, the Tri-Cities and the San Fernando Valley are approximately 10 miles away via convenient freeways like the 405, 10, 101, 134 and 110.

1880 Century Park E provides vibrant modern office suites within a well-maintained, Class A office tower at the heart of the Century City neighborhood in Los Angeles. 
      
Spanning 325,309 square feet across 15 floors, the property provides a wealth of contemporary features and amenities that make this the perfect place for a growing business. The Energy Star-labeled building offers on-site property management, valet parking with 656 covered parking spaces, and bright, well-maintained common areas. The lobby has been tastefully renovated with a fresh and inspiring design, ideal for B2B networking. Column-free suite layouts are optimized to enhance business operations, with low load factors starting at just 21.72% for multi-tenant floors and as low as 12% for single tenant floors. Additionally, all property tenants can enjoy on-site amenities such as a lobby café, a bank, Smartwell vending machines, and a print shop.
 
Nestled just off Santa Monica Boulevard at the heart of the Century City neighborhood, 1880 Century Park E places businesses with convenient proximity to major commuter arteries, quality amenities, and exceptional recreation opportunities. The prime location is within minutes of Westfield Century City, an AMC Theatre, Equinox, and the Fairmont Century Plaza Hotel. Additionally, the area is a golf lover’s paradise, sitting within five minutes of the Los Angeles Country Club, the Hillcrest Country Club, and the Rancho Park Golf Course. Navigating the property is a breeze, with convenient connections nearby to the 10 and 405 Freeways and the upcoming Purple line expansion of the Metro set to completed in the next year. 
 
Primarily known as a major business hub on the Westside of Los Angeles, The Century City lifestyle especially caters to those who want to minimize their commutes and live a life that's luxurious yet practical. The Westfield Century City shopping center takes up a sizable portion of the LA neighborhood and serves as a retail, culinary, and entertainment destination for people from all over the Westside and beyond. The neighborhood also contains several cultural amenities like the Annenberg Space for Photography and multiple art galleries. Area destinations like Rodeo Drive, the University of California Los Angeles, and Downtown Santa Monica are also within close reach of Century City.

Located in the heart of West Los Angeles, 10801 National Boulevard is a distinguished six-story commercial building offering approximately 64,000 square feet of flexible office and retail space. The building is ADA-compliant and equipped with a secure access system and extensive security cameras. 
      
With direct access to the 10 and 405 Freeways and proximity to shops, dining, and public transit, 10801 National offers exceptional connectivity and exposure. An additional opportunity to capitalize on premier building signage visible from the 10 Freeway is included. This office destination is ideally situated in West LA between Culver City and the Pico/Overland corridor, two of Los Angeles' most vibrant and sought-after business hubs. This central Westside location places the workplace at the intersection of creativity, innovation, and opportunity. 
      
Just blocks from the former Westside Pavilion, soon to be home to a major new UCLA research and innovation campus, this property's location positions business at the heart of LA's rapidly evolving tech and academic ecosystem. Join a thriving professional community surrounded by industry leaders such as Google, Amazon Studios, Apple, and Sony Pictures, all just minutes from the office doorstep. Whether an entrepreneur is in tech, media, design, or scaling a fast-growing startup, this location offers unrivaled access to the companies and talent shaping the future of LA.

This Art Deco style building was built in 1925 for Allen Maxfield. He was a Banker from Arkansas who used the Maxfield building to house his business operations, Maxfield & Co., a wholesale textile and dry goods company and factory. The LA Times once described Maxfield as a pioneer in the textile trade due to the manufacturing and later the financing for the garment industry.

In addition to his garment business, Allen Maxfield was also a member of the Board of Directors for the Seaboard National bank, which took up the 3 bays of retail space on the first floor. He was also the Director in Charge of the branch; through his experience and father/grandfathers working in the banking industry. The bank specialized in loans to garment manufacturers and development of financing the garment industry, resulting in the emergence of the industry as an international economic powerhouse. It's been stated that the garment industry would not have become an internationally recognized powerhouse without the financing provided by Maxfield and Co. Seaboard would serve conventional loans as well as be the collection agency to work on behalf of the manufacturer to collect the debts from the retailer. Within 8 years of opening, (1925-1933) the garment industry rose from 55 factories (over 1000 workers) to 316 factories (9000 workers) mainly due to the open credit Seaboard bank provided.

Bank of America purchased Seaboard in 1936 because of the substantial value. Each suite above the main floor served as a corporate office for over 100 manufacturing companies. Customers would call into the main phone line located in the lobby of the building and the operator would transfer the call throughout the building offices. The corridors are significant with solid wood doors, door frames, and commercial inspired transoms.

The building shape is exceptional with an additional 5th side view displaying neighboring downtown high rise views.

Penthouses were required to have a specific setback mandated by the Historic Preservation Offices such that they weren't visible from a certain distance. The historic preservation Secretary of Interior Standards (also known as the historic guidelines) state any additions must not appear new. For the Maxfield, this requirement opened up accessibility of each penthouse having individual outdoor patios. Signage was restored adding LED lighting.

Another significant owner of the building was Jack Needleman (ANJAC). He used the mezzanine for their corporate office for decades. Upon demolition, the owners found a safe but without the code. After hiring a safe opener, found multiple pieces of jewelry worth hundreds of thousands of dollars, and family documents, all owned by the Needleman family. Today, Steve Needleman, continues to play a role in DTLA as owner of the Orpheam Theater.

The legacy of the Maxfield building continues to shine - Don’t miss your chance to be apart of history and live in DTLA’s famous fashion district!

The Box Yard Downtown Los Angeles is a 261,528-square-foot image-raising, modern, and highly efficient multi-tenant creative, industrial, and flex campus on 325,242 square feet of land in the Downtown Los Angeles Arts District. The Box Yard boasts 24-foot-high ceilings, fenced parking, and dock-high and ground-level loading. 
         
Rexford acquired The Boxyard with the vision of redeveloping the campus into a unique industrial asset destination in Los Angeles’ Arts District. To achieve this vision, Rexford has invested significantly in enhancing the exterior and interior. Exterior improvements include new paint, enhanced wayfinding signage, upgraded landscaping, enhanced site lighting, a new park entrance, refreshed parking areas, and improved site security. Interior improvements include upgrading office finishes (including new lighting and staircases) and enhanced warehouse finishes, such as installing new bright skylights and LED lighting. 
    
Blocks away from the Arts District strip and New Soho House, less than 2 miles away, The Box Yard is centrally located in the heart of Los Angeles, nestled between mountains, sandy shorelines, and a bustling commercial district. Tenants will have immediate accessibility to the 10 Freeway and Interstate 5 in less than a two-minute drive. The Box Yard is ideally positioned adjacent to the Los Angeles River in this premier downtown historic neighborhood, where tenants and visitors can enjoy local breweries, entertainment, restaurants, and retail hotspots within a 10-minute drive. 
      
The Box Yard is the ideal business park for e-commerce, tech, entertainment, studio, fashion, art, and creative users to occupy space in a creative industrial flex building. All available units at this creative business park are turnkey, and some units can be combined. Join top brands such as the Berrics, Undefeated, and The Daily Look at The Box Yard, all strategically located in an Opportunity Zone offering potential tenant benefits in the desirable Downtown Los Angeles Area.

Attain a highly connected space to work in the Houston metro with the affordability and flexibility offered by Workstyle, coupled with the immense on-site advantages at 7324 Southwest Freeway of the Arena Place office park.
  
Two Arena Place provides an elegant, upscale experience from the Class A finishes to the efficiency-maximizing amenities. The office is ultra-convenient with an on-site parking garage, keycard access, shipping drop boxes, a medical clinic, sundry shop, and more so teams can stay on the go. Two Arena Place is owned and operated by Boxer Property, a key advantage as the experienced Texas-based firm has a portfolio of over 150 buildings and is headquartered in the building. The full-service company can address most needs in-house and is constantly making improvements for its tenants, like the brand-new on-site restaurant and bar that opened in late 2023. 
  
Workstyle executive suites are Boxer Property’s signature hybrid of co-working and private offices that provide startups and small business owners the opportunity to rent individual spaces at a fraction of the cost of a traditional office space. There are furnished and unfurnished options, and members benefit from shared amenities like free Wi-Fi, a coffee bar, conference rooms, huddle rooms, and a training room. 
  
Located along Interstate 69, approximately midway between Downtown Houston and Sugar Land, Arena Place ideally balances proximity to key residential zones and professional hubs. Organizations can quickly reach places like Texas Medical Center, Energy Corridor, and IAH Airport for business needs and easily commute home to popular communities such as Missouri City, Sugar Land, and Rosenberg. There are several amenities just outside of the office for the convenience of workers here, too. Adjacent to the building are Wendy’s, Jack in the Box, Pollo Riko, Fung’s Kitchen, a monthly farmers market, and Arena Theatre, from which tenants can get discounted tickets. The PlazAmericas Mall is also under a 15-minute walk away, and the highway access extends tenants’ reach to amenities even further.

Hines and Ivanhoé Cambridge are developing Texas Tower, a new 47-story, one-million-square-foot office tower on the 800 block of Texas Avenue (the former site of the Houston Chronicle). The building will become an architectural presence in Houston’s skyline, and offer a radical new approach to lobby and common-area design and activation. Designed by Pelli Clarke Pelli, the project will be built to the highest standards that Hines has ever developed in Houston, including LEED® Platinum, WiredScore and WELL™ Building Standards. Texas Tower will feature unprecedented amenities in the vertically integrated campus, including: a dramatic lobby with cues from the hospitality sector; multiple food and beverage offerings; abundant spaces for networking; a full-service conference facility; public gardens on level 12; and a high-performance fitness center. Ten-foot, full-height windows will allow for an abundance of natural light across the 30,000-square-foot floor plates and a sophisticated underfloor HVAC system will put comfort choices in the hands of occupants. Protruding, cantilevered bays on each face of the floorplate project away from the building providing opportunities for dramatic internal stairs, atriums and communal spaces, as well as potential access to fresh air and outdoor green space. The tower will be placed diagonally on the site resulting in unique, more interesting view angles and a powerful civic presence. The unique site is at the confluence of the CBD, the Theatre District and the Historic District—Houston’s ‘main and main’ location for a lively place to live, work and play. The building’s desirable location leverages the myriad of restaurants, bars and entertainment venues, as well as an exploding residential population. Texas Tower is scheduled to open in late 2021.

The Granada Buildings is an imaginative, Mediterranean- and Spanish Colonial Revival-style block-long complex comprising four courtyard-connected structures encompassing over 60,000 square feet. The two-story studios were initially built as live-work spaces in 1927 by Franklin Harper, a Kentucky-born journalist turned developer.
      
Over the years, the Granada Buildings developed a reputation as one of LA's creative centers, housing some of its best-known architects, artists, and designers. The complex was renovated and reopened in 1990 as 42 office/studio suites.
      
In the Westlake District of Downtown Los Angeles, a historic area adjacent to Lafayette Park, tenants will enjoy an impressive city skyline and a peaceful, picturesque park. The Granada Buildings offer easy connectivity to the 10, 110, and 101 Freeways, providing efficient travel times to the office. Just 2 miles from Downtown Los Angeles, this destination is within reach of all the retail, dining, and entertainment attractions this sprawling city offers.

The Ion is Houston’s nucleus of innovation, fostering a collaborative and inclusive community. Linking educational institutions, incubators, accelerators, businesses, investors, and artists, The Ion is creating pathways for the future workforce. In the heart of Midtown’s transformational 16-acre urban innovation district, The Ion was a 1930s-era, futuristic showroom, now dramatically reimagined and purpose-built for today. A world-class team, including SHoP Architects, James Corner Field Operations, James Carpenter and Associates, and Gensler, designed a jaw-dropping, 266,000-square-foot space opening onto an actively programmed, half-acre outdoor plaza. Steps from the Wheeler MetroRail station, and oriented for easy pedestrian, bike, train, bus, and rideshare access, The Ion is centrally located less than 0.5 miles from Downtown, 1 mile from the Museum District and Rice University, and 1.5 miles from the Texas Medical Center. The Ion delivers a comprehensive range of services and amenities to support sustainability, wellness, and resilience, including: Class-A offices, creative lounges, tech-powered conference rooms, craft coffee, and state-of-the-art coworking with ergonomic sit/stand desks, abundant natural light, and flexible suites for growing teams. The Ion is an enduring, tangible, and financial commitment to Houston’s future by Rice University and its partners.

10700 Richmond Avenue is a premier three-story office building located in the desirable Westchase business district and neighborhood. Wrapped in reflective floor-to-ceiling glass, providing a signature look and ample interior natural light, this best-in-class building makes a prominent statement within the Houston metro. Visitors are welcomed by a serene multi-level atrium featuring indoor foliage and organic design details constructed from sustainable materials.  
 
Efficient floor plans are available, starting with executive offices to over 7,000-square-foot suites with various layouts, many of which are move-in-ready spec suites. Property amenities include monument signage, on-site security, a passenger elevator, after-hours card-key access, a tenant-exclusive conference room, tenant lounge, and covered parking. For additional peace of mind, enjoy responsive on-site property management and 24-hour interior and exterior security camera surveillance. 
  
Commuting to 10700 Richmond Avenue is seamless for both transit riders and drivers, tapping tenants into key labor pools. The building is conveniently located on a Metro bus line and minutes away from both the Sam Houston and Westpark tollways. For drivers, take advantage of hassle-free parking in one of the property’s 250 covered surface-parking spaces. These locational factors have brought high-profile companies to the area. Phillips 66, APA Corp., Jacobs, Bechtel Corp., Quest Diagnostics, Chevron, Honeywell, and more have significant corporate office presences within 2 miles of this property, opening broad partnership opportunities. 
  
Convenience is a paramount advantage of 10700 Richmond Avenue, thanks to ample nearby dining, shopping, hospitality, and entertainment options. Tenants can get to Royal Oaks Country Club, Memorial City Mall, The Galleria, dozens of hotels, Sharptstown Park Golf Course, and much more in 15 minutes or less. Amenity-rich, professionally prominent, and guaranteed to impress, 10700 Richmond Avenue is a prestigious location, suitable for all business needs.

notes.value: Presidents Park is Houston's newest and most flexible master-planned industrial project. The first installment, Presidents Park 5 can suit either single or multi-tenant needs with glass storefront entrances on both ends and ample auto and trailer parking. The state-of-the-art, front-load space has 32' clear height, a modern 185' truck court, LED interior and exterior lights, and ESFR sprinklers. The park itself is undergoing major infrastructure improvements, including upgrading and expanding Milner Road for easier and quicker access in and out of the park. Presidents Park’s strategic location in North Houston, immediately south of IAH Airport, provides unmatched access to the ever-growing Houston MSA population and business centers. The park is located less than five miles from all three major north/south arteries, including I-45, Hardy Toll Road, and Hwy 59. It boasts immediate access to Beltway 8 and a 10-minute drive to the 610 Loop for excellent circulation around Houston. This key location, combined with Presidents Park’s best-in-class design and state-of-the-art facilities, creates an ideal setting for future growth.

Prologis Presidents Park is one of Houston's newest and most flexible master-planned industrial projects. The Park offers over 187-acres of developable land for a combination of speculative development, build-to-suit, and design-build projects. Presidents Park has undergone major infrastructure improvements, including upgrading and expanding Milner Road for easier and quicker access in and out of the Park. The Hollywood Athletic Club and Sunset Towers present a compelling opportunity to lease corner offices with extraordinary views of LA or host exclusive events, film and music productions, art installations, or immersive events in the epicenter of the Hollywood community. The Sunset Towers' corner offices, sweeping views, and range of spaces make it ideal for medical spas, therapists, and creative arts/media companies. The adjacent Hollywood Athletic Club oozes with old Hollywood glamour, featuring a stately entrance on Sunset Boulevard, arched ceilings with murals in the opulent Moroccan room, hand-painted beams and vintage carved oak bars in the Venetian Room, and a grand winding staircase, to name a few.  
    
When it opened in 1924 on New Year’s Eve, 6525 W Sunset Boulevard was the tallest structure in Los Angeles. It was designed by Meyer & Holler, the architectural firm famous for Grauman’s Egyptian and Chinese Theatres. Founded by the most esteemed Hollywood players, including Charlie Chaplin, Rudolph Valentino, and Cecil B. DeMille, The Hollywood Athletic Club has been and continues to be the magnetic gathering place for the entertainment community. The first Emmy Awards were held here on January 24, 1949, and they recently celebrated their 75th anniversary here, with the Emmy Nominations Announcement in July 2023.  
    
In 1978, The Hollywood Athletic Club was repurchased and restored as an entertainment mecca, becoming a nightclub, a restaurant, and a billiards club. In this century, The Hollywood Athletic Club has been blessed with distinguished hosts, including President Obama and President Clinton, the Rolling Stones, David Bowie, and Britney Spears. It was the chosen site for noteworthy special events such as LA Fashion Week, Grammy Celebrations, Oscar Academy Awards Galas, and luxury brands for Hermes, Tiffany and Nieman Marcus, among others.
     
Approaching its 100th anniversary in Spring 2024, the property has undergone a significant restoration and has returned to its original grandeur as an architectural gem. An engaged owner and dedicated staff have thoughtfully maintained the property to instill the feeling of the old Hollywood era from the last century. The property provides an experienced and responsive on-site management team for resident tenants, visitors, and event hosts. It is fortunate to have a very large parking lot with an attendant to accommodate all parking needs, including lot rentals.
     
The Hollywood Athletic Club is at the epicenter of all that Hollywood has to offer. Sunset Boulevard is one of the most famous streets in Los Angeles, spanning over 22 miles of arts and media institutions, entertainment, shopping, restaurants, and the glitz and glimmering lights of nightlife. A walkable location, members can grab coffee at Philz Coffee, lunch at Superba Food+Bread across the street, catch happy hour at Bar Lis a block away, then see a show at the Cinelounge. 
      
The palatial open spaces in The Hollywood Athletic Club are waiting for the imagination of the entertainment community, while over 20 corner offices enjoy terrific views of the Hollywood Hills. The Los Angeles Valley provides the most compelling and inspirational backdrop for business and pleasure!

Obtain an investment position in Village Towers, a high-quality asset tailored to market trends and located in an abounding submarket of Houston. Moody Village Towers DST is the “Trust” in which speculative and prospective investors will be purchasing Class A beneficial ownership interests.

Village Towers is a mixed-use complex spanning approximately 325,000 square feet that was developed in 2019. The marquee properties of the campus are made up of two six-story office towers connected via a skyway prominently poised over Katy Freeway with a curtain wall of blue-hued glass wrapped around them. The towers are connected by two sky bridges to Village Towers Plaza, a stepped, seven-story parking garage with 43,249 square feet of ground-floor retail featuring local Houston restaurants. The office space is almost fully leased to a robust mix of tenants with minimal vacant retail suites, pinning the total occupancy at 97%.

Moody National set out to create a project centered around the modern consumer and tenant mindset when developing Village Towers. It embraces the flight to quality and emphasis on convenience that has characterized office demand in recent years. Quality effuses everywhere, from the lobby’s Italian marble to granite-paved curbless sidewalks. Convenience is maximized by the on-site parking garage, state-of-the-art fitness center, locker room facilities, town hall meeting space, Wi-Fi-enabled outdoor space, on-campus food options, and a location around some of Houston’s most sought-after communities.

Located in the Memorial Hedwig Village neighborhood, Village Towers is at a prime focal point of residential interest. The suburbs here are ranked in the 2024 top 10 by Niche for places to live in the Houston area, with market-leading schools like Memorial High School and high-traffic commercial hubs like Memorial City Mall and CityCentre, all within 3 miles of the property. Village Towers is also in the broader Katy Freeway East office submarket, one of the 10 largest submarkets by inventory in Houston, with over 13 million square feet of existing space. Despite the vast supply, built-in advantages like nearby amenities, popular communities, and well-educated households have upheld demand. Vacancy rates are suppressed compared to the overall Houston market, and the submarket commands the second highest rents in the metro, behind only the CBD, per CoStar.

West Oaks Plaza occupies a highly visible position at the corner of Westheimer Road and Richmond Avenue, offering businesses an opportunity to establish a presence along one of West Houston's most kinetic retail corridors. With 315 feet of frontage on Westheimer Road, signage opportunities, four curb cuts, and exposure to nearly 29,400 vehicles per day, the center delivers the visibility and accessibility that help businesses stand out. Positioned adjacent to West Oaks Mall and near George Bush Park, West Oaks Plaza benefits from the activity generated by two of the area's most recognizable destinations. 
      
A strong mix of established tenants, including a spa, bakery, and barbershop, contributes to a vibrant shopping environment and encourages repeat visits to the center. Their loyal customer base helps create steady activity throughout the day, giving businesses the opportunity to benefit from existing consumer traffic and visibility. 
      
Located within Houston's thriving Far Katy South Submarket, West Oaks Plaza provides convenient access to the Energy Corridor, Cinco Ranch, Mission Bend, Eldridge Parkway, Highway 6, and Interstate 10. More than 1.45 million residents live within a 10-mile radius, supported by average household incomes of $103,972 and $15.9 billion in annual consumer spending, making this a compelling location for businesses looking to be part of a dynamic retail corridor.

One Westchase Center is a striking office tower nestled into a beautifully landscaped park-like setting featuring two reflection ponds with water fountains. Tenants and guests are welcomed by a glass and granite-clad skylit atrium rising the building's full 12 stories, with a stylishly designed podium featuring lavish tropical vegetation surrounding a cascading pool. The iconic atrium splits the building into north and south "pods" with a series of cantilevered balconies overlooking the lobby. With expansive 40,000-square-foot floor plates, the unique pod floor plan allows for full-floor presence for 25,000-square-foot North Pod and 15,000-square-foot and South Pod tenants. Grab breakfast and lunch at the on-site deli, host an in-person or virtual meeting in the conference center, and get a workout at the state-of-the-art fitness center. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Houston's up-and-coming Westchase district, One Westchase Center is steps from popular shopping and trendy eateries along Westheimer Road, the area's main retail corridor. This strategic location also provides tenants with an effortless commute, featuring a covered walkway from the parking deck, direct access to Sam Houston Parkway, two miles from Westpark Tollway, and five miles from Interstate 10.

Secure a position on the cutting edge of medicine, science, academia, and commerce in the visionary TMC Helix Park campus. The first of four industry buildings, Dynamic One, will provide innovative research labs, superior modern office space, and luxurious common areas where the best minds in life sciences can collaborate and discover the next medical breakthrough.

Phase I encompasses 350,000 square feet of Class A office and wet-lab space spanning ten stories, with Phase II bringing its total footprint to 700,000 square feet in 2025. Dynamic One will feature a state-of-the-art fitness center, 200-person lecture hall, tenant lounge with a catering room, and glistening terraces overlooking Helix Park, the luscious green space winding through the campus evoking the shape of DNA structure. It will also include an expansive Great Hall adjacent to the lobby and public retail and restaurant space on the first floor, like all of TMC3’s facilities.


The Texas Medical Center is the largest medical city in the world, servicing over 10 million patient encounters each year and home to 1/5th of all medical clinics. While already in a class of its own, the TMC3 campus expansion to the south will bring an additional five million square feet, accelerating the discovery and delivery of life-changing advancements. The Texas Medical Center alone is the eighth largest business district in the US, and TMC3 will redefine the modern medical community by creating an inflection point of science and commerce.


TMC3 will bring a 250,000-square-foot collaborative building, a 700,000-square-foot industry research building, 18.7 acres of public space, a 521-room hotel with an expansive conference center, and a 350-unit residential tower with retail lining the street level of the campus. Professionals can start their morning with an espresso from the Great Hall, attend a seminar on the latest healthcare developments, and apply what they’ve learned in the world-class laboratories before retiring to their quarters overlooking the commanding Houston skyline. TMC3 emphasizes walkability and allows medical experts to embrace the modern live-work lifestyle, simultaneously fostering creativity and wellness to focus on the next earth-shaking discovery.

7800 Washington is a bold collection of design showrooms, offices, services, and a chef-driven restaurant, strategically positioned within Houston’s 610 Loop, just north of Interstate 10. Originally constructed in the 1960s as a 66,000-square-foot red-brick historic warehouse, the property has been transformed into an award-winning adaptive reuse development. It now hosts a stately roster of tenants with a local presence and a national reach, in sectors like finance, interior design, high-concept architecture, luxury services, and more. 
  
New lessees can join these high-profile businesses in 7800 Washington’s final vacancy. Suite 650 epitomizes the innovative and creative character of 7800 Washington and the Houston Design District. The 2,836-square-foot space fosters a warm, bohemian style that elegantly coalesces the property’s industrial elements with rustic features. Exposed ceilings, vintage lighting, polished concrete floors, brilliant paned windows, nostalgic furniture, and heritage-style fixtures form an irreplicable charm. Suite 650 sports an open layout with a welcoming reception area and conference rooms in place, but the highly modular space can be customized to suit a wide range of businesses. 
  
Situated in the thriving Washington Avenue corridor known as the Houston Design District, one of Houston’s most vibrant mixed-use neighborhoods, 7800 Washington is surrounded by world-class dining, newly developed high-rise residences, and a lively nightlife scene. This area has rapidly evolved into a key urban destination with notable hotspots in the vicinity, including the Somerset Green master-planned community and the Houston Design Center.
  
Adding another level of convenience, 7800 Washington is centrally positioned near some of Houston’s more established hubs such as The Heights, The Galleria, CityCentre, and downtown. The location offers exceptional metro connectivity via immediate access to major freeways, including Interstate 10, Loop 610, and US 290. It is also conveniently positioned for travel, with Bush Intercontinental Airport just 35 minutes away and Hobby Airport reachable in a short 25-minute drive. 
  
Work in this vibrant locale and help define the Houston Design District with this one-of-a-kind space at 7800 Washington today. Get in touch.

Discover the quality and convenience of this high-end office complex with the backdrop of market-leading on-campus and surrounding amenities by leasing space at Galleria Park, owned by Dhanani Private Equity Group.   
  
5251 and 5333 Westheimer Road comprise Galleria Park, spanning 11 and 10 stories around the new Grand Lawn. The landlord has rolled out a comprehensive spec suite program to outfit the suites with custom-designed finishes and lighting, providing mostly move-in-ready spaces. There are also large blocks of contiguous space for substantial users with possible signage rights available. Ownership has plenty of capital to provide custom build-outs or tenant improvement allowances.   
  
Galleria Park was built with first-class amenities, like the expansive parking garage and upscale tenant lounge, and ownership significantly elevated Galleria Park with the completion of a $15 million renovation in 2018. A marquee addition is the Grand Lawn, a 1-acre park designed to give people a place to relax and recharge. The park boasts Wi-Fi-enabled promenades and pavilions, recreation and event space, outdoor games, and sprawling native landscaping with live oaks and rich, green grass. OMG Burgers, Hachi Sushi, and the first Houston location of STK Steakhouse will be joining PF Chang’s as on-site food options. Additional amenities include a state-of-the-art fitness center, a new 2,000-square-foot conference facility, and spa-quality, full-service locker rooms.   
  
The Galleria is adjacent to the office complex, forming a mixed-use oasis unlike any other in the Houston metro, brimming with over 400 stores and 60 eateries. It boasts a desirable Uptown location, favored by some of the best talent in the metro, as the combination of connectivity and amenities has beckoned thousands of affluent, well-educated residents to households around here. The commutability of Galleria Park is excellent for those living outside of Uptown, too, with the intersection of Loop 610 and Southwest Freeway a mile away. Sugar Land is under 20 minutes away, Katy residents can get here in about 30 minutes, and drives from as far as The Woodlands range from 35 to 45 minutes. Take advantage of this spectrum of intrinsic factors and see how work and life elegantly come together at Galleria Park today.

Hold a commanding position in the Houston metro just outside of the 610 West Loop with one of the versatile spaces at Mitchelldale Business Park. 
   
The park features office and warehouse flex spaces with grade-level and dock-high loading configurations available. Tenants enjoy peace of mind with on-site management and leasing, plus they can greatly increase their brand exposure with exterior and monument signage available. A wide range of businesses can utilize the spaces with ample parking to accommodate employees or even clients. Some of the existing tenants here include an athletic club, a theater, automotive shops, online stores, office users, and training centers, underpinning the flexibility of these spaces. 
  
Situated just off US 290 and a mile from Interstate 610, Mitchelldale Business Park is the ideal vantage point to tap into the vast labor and client pools around Downtown Houston and the greater metro area. There are over 1.5 million people within a 10-mile radius coming from all walks of life, as evident by an even distribution of household incomes. There are several stores and restaurants within walking distance for convenient workforce amenities, and The Galleria is a 10-minute drive away with even more options.

North Park 34 derives its name from the 34 buildings that comprise the business park, underpinning the collective’s ability to provide space variety and scale occupied footprints to coincide with a tenant’s need. Suites range from 100% office layouts to warehouses with various loading configurations of dock-high doors and grade-level drive-ins. The majority of spaces have a mix of office and warehouse space, granting tremendous flexibility to transform the open areas. North Park 34’s eclectic group of tenants indicates with organizations such as churches, boutique gyms, finance groups, fabrication shops, wholesalers, tech firms, and installation services already operating here. Tenants can take occupancy quickly as most of the suites are in make-ready condition and there is ample surface parking throughout the park to accommodate teams and clients.
  
Located near the crossing of Hardy Toll Road and Beltway 8, North Park 34 has a location appealing to the broad spectrum of users it serves. Industrial tenants have a skilled workforce to tap into with nearly 85,000 warehouse workers within a 10-mile radius, and the proximity to George Bush Intercontinental Airport is prime for streamlined air freight distribution. Office users will be right off the highway for white collar workers coming from enclaves like Spring or The Woodlands, and Interstate 45 is a direct shot to professional hubs in Downtown Houston. All tenants have great access to amenities as well with Greenspoint Mall 2 miles away and over 100 restaurants within a 10-minute drive. Take advantage of this versatile location with the equally adaptable spaces at North Park 34 today.

Secure a highly functional point of operations in the dynamic Northeast Atlanta submarket and join some of the most significant players in the region with this tenant-ready leasing opportunity at 421 Toy Wright Road in Pendergrass, Georgia.
  
Northeast 85 Logistics Center was delivered in 2023 and spans 1,174,012 square feet, making it the largest spec building on the market in the Northeast Atlanta submarket. The cross-dock distribution warehouse is divisible to 600,000 square feet and is move-in ready with the spec office space now complete. Northeast 85 Logistics Center is primed to handle intensive distribution operations with 241 9’ x 10’ insulated dock-high doors (121 with 40,000 lb mechanical levelers), four 14’ x 16’ ramped drive-in doors, and 277/480 volt, 3-phase power. The warehouse area features a 6-inch Ductilcrete slab, 40-foot minimum clear height, 56’ x 50’ column spacing with 60’ loading bays, LED lighting, and an ESFR sprinkler system. The 78.69-acre site provides a 185-foot truck court, 517 auto parking spaces, and 287 trailer storage locations. Northeast 85 Logistics Center also features 10 battery charger connections, a major advantage as the battery and solar sectors are now flourishing in Georgia.
  
Located minutes from Interstate 85 with three exits serving the property, Northeast 85 Logistics Center commands a powerful position capable of reaching a number of key regional hubs within a few hours. The Appalachian Regional Inland Port is about 2.5 hours from the center and provides a direct rail line to Savannah, but the port is only half the drive time to Savannah. Transporters can easily serve wealthy communities in the North Atlanta area and the powerful Greenville and Spartanburg markets that have benefited tremendously from investment in the electrification of vehicles and high-tech manufacturing. Georgia is seeing a similar trend of investments in these industries as well, making this a great opportunity for users serving those operations. The existing SK Battery plant in Jackson County is 15 minutes up Interstate 85 from the center, and the joint plant from Hyundai and SK Battery is opening in Cartersville in 2025. Hanwha Qcells also has a battery plant in Dalton, GA, and Hyundai and LG recently announced a new venture near Savannah.

WorkBay – Hempstead is a five-building flex and light-industrial park totaling 118,444 SF of rentable building area in northwest Houston, Texas. Constructed in 1980, the property is configured as 79 suites ranging from 1,271 to 3,080 SF, with an average unit size of approximately 1,500 SF.

The unit mix is consistent and efficient: 68 suites from 1,271 to 1,345 SF make up nearly nine in ten units, a size that works for a wide range of trades and service businesses. Eleven larger suites from 2,324 to 3,080 SF serve those who need more room. The five-building layout supports drive-up loading and dedicated tenant parking, with two dedicated parking stalls per unit.

Every unit is served by a private office with office AC, a private bathroom, 13'–15' exposed ceilings, a grade-level 10'×10' roll-up door, and single-phase power. Select suites add a private yard or a kitchenette. Automotive, mechanic, and dealer uses are permitted throughout the park.

The property is not subject to municipal zoning, offering broad use flexibility for contractor, service, automotive, mechanic, dealer, and light-industrial uses.

The property is covered by park-wide CCTV security and offers a dedicated regional manager, 24/7 tenant access, and USPS mailbox service.

Access is strong. The park sits in northwest Houston with both Beltway 8 and US-290 just 3–5 minutes out, giving tenants fast routes around the city and northwest toward Cypress. That position suits contractors, trades, automotive, and service businesses working accounts across northwest Houston and the surrounding suburbs. George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) is 25–27 minutes away.

2250 S Barrington Avenue is a two-story, 18,572-square-foot standalone building in Los Angeles, California. This flex facility is fully built-out with a spacious lobby space and break room on the first floor, two expansive open areas on the first through second floors with a space open to above and below, and private offices and balconies on the second floors. Each elevator-served level has storage rooms, bathrooms, and elevator lobbies. Constructed in 1958 and renovated in 2012, the property has desirable features, including 11-foot ceilings, excellent natural light, exposed brick, ample parking, and premium building signage. 
      
2250 S Barrington Avenue is in a prime central location between Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, and Culver City. With excellent access to the 10 and 405 freeways in less than five minutes, users can connect to Phoenix, San Francisco, and Sacramento business hubs within a day's drive. The Los Angeles International Airport lies 9 miles away for international and cross-country travel needs. Strategically located amid Silicon Beach, 2250 S Barrington Avenue is near leading tech companies, including Hulu, Meta, Google, YouTube, Amazon, and Microsoft. For tech, media, and professional businesses looking for flex space in West Los Angeles, 2250 S Barrington Avenue is the ideal choice.

Located at the base of 1000 Grand by Windsor, a 273-unit residential community in Downtown Los Angeles, 448 W Olympic Blvd offers a rare opportunity to secure restaurant and retail space within one of the city's most active mixed-use neighborhoods. The property sits along the highly traveled Olympic Boulevard corridor near the intersection of Grand Avenue, placing tenants within walking distance of major residential developments, office buildings, entertainment venues, hotels, and destination retail.
The available restaurant space is fully built out as a second-generation pizza restaurant, providing an opportunity for operators seeking a faster path to occupancy. The retail space offers existing improvements and flexibility for a variety of concepts. Property features include approximately 14-foot ceiling heights, a Master CUP in place, existing gas service, cold water service, a 200-amp electrical panel, and split HVAC units. Customer convenience is supported by available four-hour street parking.
The surrounding area benefits from a dense concentration of residents, office workers, visitors, and students. Nearby destinations include Grand Central Market, Walt Disney Concert Hall, LA Live, the Los Angeles Convention Center, Whole Foods, Erewhon, Equinox, and numerous restaurants and hospitality venues. The property is also surrounded by existing and planned multifamily developments, supporting sustained neighborhood activity throughout the day and evening.
2,434 SF second generation restaurant space.

Corporate Plaza is a three-building collective comprised of two Class A office towers and a multi-tenant retail center. The offices feature efficient floor plates, perfect for tenants of any size. Interior renovations delivered in 2024, including a new conference center, tenant lounge and modernized lobbies and restrooms. The property also features a key card access system, on-site property management, monument signage opportunities, and ample covered parking. Corporate Plaza's unique spaces provide a synergetic mix of on-site amenities for office workers and a built-in pool of daily customers for stores and restaurants.  
  
Exceptional visibility and accessibility are two key factors that elevate Corporate Plaza over other Southeast Houston mixed-use centers. Traffic is generated by the wealthy residences around Bay Oaks Country Club, NASA Johnson Space Center, and the University of Houston – Clear Lake surrounding Corporate Plaza. Kemah Boardwalk, Clear Lake Regional Medical Center, and Baybrook Mall are a few miles away. Corporate Plaza is conveniently situated between Interstate 45 (Gulf Freeway) and Highway 146 (Bayport Boulevard). Even with the benefit of highway connectivity, tenants usually do not have to commute for food or errands since several amenities are at their doorstep. Anytime Fitness, Dollar Tree, Petco, Stone’s Gym, and over 15 restaurants are within a 10-minute walk from Corporate Plaza.

The Williams Tower is a 64-story, 1.4-million-square-foot Class A office tower located in the Uptown District of Houston, Texas. At 909 feet above the ground level, the Williams Tower is the tallest building in Houston outside of Downtown Houston. When it was constructed in 1983, it was also the world's tallest skyscraper outside of a city's Central Business District.  
      
The building was built to function as two separate towers stacked directly on top of one another, one comprising the first forty floors, and the other the forty-first to sixty-fourth. The building has separate elevator banks and lobbies for each of the two building sections. A majority of the bottom 40 floors are occupied by Williams. The remainder of the building is occupied by a variety of tenants.  
      
Williams Tower was named "Skyscraper of the Century" in the December 1999 issue of Texas Monthly magazine. Paul Gapp of the Chicago Tribune said that the building became an "instant classic" when it opened. Paul Goldberger of The New York Times said that the tower gave Post Oak Boulevard "a center, an anchor, which most towns lack."  
      
There are six elevators that take tenants to the 51st floor, where they can transfer to other elevators to reach the 49th through 64th floors of the building. There is no public observation deck.  
      
During the night, the building is defined by a 7,000-watt beacon that sweeps across the sky and can be seen up to 40 miles away on a clear night. Topped by such a beacon, the tower hearkens back to the Palmolive Building in Chicago, Illinois. The building, along with its beacon, is a Houston landmark that identifies the Uptown Houston district.

Generously offering spec suites sporting an open layout to provide maximum flexibility and efficiency for modern businesses. Downtown Los Angeles continues to attract tenants due to its proximity to clients, infrastructure, and ability to draw talent from across the region. Businesses here benefit from a dynamic ecosystem of high-end showrooms, wholesale apparel vendors, and cutting-edge design studios. 
         
Whether launching a flagship retail store, establishing a creative headquarters, or opening a destination restaurant, 221 East 12th Street offers flexibility, exposure, and location to elevate a brand in one of Los Angeles' most energetic and influential districts.

Travis Medical Center is strategically located right at the gateway to the world’s largest medical complex, offering unparalleled visibility and accessibility. Under new ownership, this premier medical office building is being reimagined to deliver an elevated experience for healthcare professionals and their patients.

Travis Medical Center is undergoing a bold transformation. A stunning new lobby and modernized exterior are just the beginning. A multimillion-dollar renovation is underway, transforming the lobby, portico breezeway for covered tenant and patient main entrance access, and streetscape with a modern, design-forward aesthetic. Convenience is already a priority with on-site parking available and will soon be elevated further with the addition of valet services — ensuring seamless access for both physicians and patients.
  
Travis Medical Center offers several move-in-ready, second-generation medical suites designed for a variety of specialties, including dental, dermatology, hematology, podiatry, and pediatrics. For those looking to customize their space, white-box and shell spaces are also available. Professionally managed by industry leader Hines, the property offers on-site engineering and security teams, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations and peace of mind for tenants.
  
Flexible leasing options are available, with negotiable tenant improvements, competitive lease rates, and short-term options to accommodate a range of needs. Annual base rental rates start at $28.00 per square foot on a Full-Service Gross lease, significantly below the average rents in the TMC.
  
Travis Medical Center offers unmatched convenience. With direct connectivity to the adjacent Hilton, tenants enjoy access to a state-of-the-art fitness center, Starbucks Barista kiosk, pool deck with fire pits, cocktail bar, Herb-N-Kitchen delicatessen, catering services, and conference facilities. The property’s location on the edge of the TMC makes it one of the most accessible buildings in the world’s largest medical complex.
  
At the Epicenter of Global Medical Innovation: The Texas Medical Center
Spanning 1,400 acres, the Texas Medical Center is home to over 375,000 professionals, 60 medical institutions, and 300+ cutting-edge research labs. The Travis Medical Center is surrounded by renowned institutions such as Texas Children’s Hospital, St. Luke’s Health, and Houston Methodist, placing your practice among the elite in healthcare. With 20 universities and colleges—including Baylor College of Medicine and Rice University—located within TMC, tenants benefit from exceptional opportunities for research, education, and collaboration. With over 10 million patients served annually at TMC, Travis Medical Center places practices at the forefront of medical excellence - boosting both visibility and prestige.
  
Inquire today to elevate your practice in the heart of innovation.

7272 N Shepherd Drive is the premier opportunity for practices to establish themselves in a rapidly evolving area with a steeply increasing population and personal incomes. 
    
The freestanding building spans approximately 5,274 square feet and features an efficient layout, fully organized for medical, surgical, dental, or oral surgery practices and more. The former occupant is expanding into a large adjacent ambulatory surgical center (ASC), leaving it in operation-ready condition. 7272 N Shepherd Drive features doctors' offices, exam rooms, plumbed for medical gas (Oxygen), operating rooms, procedure prep areas, a built-out nurses' station, records storage, clean work areas, a conference room, a reception desk, a waiting area, space for lab equipment, and more. It also has two radiation-safe procedure/operating rooms, making this an easy takeover for breast cancer centers, orthopedics, sports medicine, dental or oral surgery, and more. Access is easy with ample parking, wheelchair-accessible entry, and a separate ambulance entrance. 
     
The landlord has recently made upgrades, including repainting, replacing fencing, power washing, restriping parking areas, and paving repairs. 7272 N Shepherd Drive's robust infrastructure readies it for intensive operations. It includes two new full-capacity HVAC units and another smaller unit, extensive plumbing for users such as dental practices, oxygen for medical usage, and a retention pond that has prevented flooding during several major storms. The annual lease rate is $15 per square foot, with an additional $8.75 per square foot in triple-net (estimated tax, insurance, and CAM expenses). The landlord will also consider a lower lease rate per square foot depending on lease start, duration of lease, and build-outs/modifications. 
    
Located in a private area next to a courthouse and police station, 7272 N Shepherd Drive offers a safe, secluded location while still providing maximum exposure along the heavily traveled thoroughfare, with tower signage directly off the street. N Shepherd Drive is a four-lane road that leads directly to the center of Houston, providing visibility to about 30,000 vehicles per day, and Interstate 45 is only a half-mile away, enhancing accessibility. Kindred Healthcare has a large footprint in the immediate vicinity, already making this a go-to medical destination. As an established area for healthcare needs, 7272 N Shepherd Drive is a valuable address to serve the gentrifying environment. This trend is immediately visible from the building's doorstep, with new condo buildings popping up around it. In fact, the number of households within a 2-mile radius grew by 8.8% from 2020 to 2024 and is estimated to rise by another 8% through 2029. The current demographic landscape already has a high prevalence of kidney disease and diabetes, and the dynamic changes happening in the area will increase demand for even more specialties.

A two-time winner of Houston BOMA’s “Building of the Year,” Wells Fargo Plaza is the center of Houston’s contemporary skyline, standing 992 feet tall with 71 stories of tenant floors. Wells Fargo Plaza is the largest multi-tenant building in the southwestern United States with more than 1.7 million square feet of rentable area. The building occupies an entire city block, bounded by Louisiana, Lamar, Smith and McKinney Streets and is on the Houston Tunnel System. 

Wells Fargo Plaza features the exclusive health club services of Club 1000. Club 1000 is a 16,000 square foot state-of-the art facility featuring cardiovascular equipment, free weights and resistance training machines, Cardio-theater, a Pilates studio, a group exercise classroom for a variety of other strength and toning classes and luxurious men’s and women’s locker rooms-each including a beautiful lounge and steam room. A staff of certified professionals is available for personal training, weight management and nutrition consulting, private Pilates instruction and massage therapy. Tenant discount programs are available. 

To accommodate visitor and VIP parking, Wells Fargo Plaza has implemented a valet parking service in the basement garage of the building. Clients and customers simply drive up to the valet stand and enjoy the ease and convenience of valet parking. Competitive hourly and daily rates make this the optimal parking option for guests to the building. The basement garage at Wells Fargo Plaza contains 428 parking spaces and there are an additional 1,600 spaces at the 1311 Louisiana garage, both are connected to the building via climate controlled tunnel system. 

Other in-building services at Wells Fargo Plaza include a full-service bank, car butler auto detailing services, deli, shoe shine stand, WiFi hot spots and on-site leasing and management offices. Adair Downtown, 1000 Louisiana’s exclusive restaurant and bar is located on the tunnel level. Additionally, there are more than 50 food and beverage operations located within a two block radius of the building and adjacent hotels provide more than 1,300 rooms collectively.

The Blackstone Building was included in the National Register of Historic Place’s Broadway Theater and Commercial District in 2002. In 2003, the building received its designation as Los Angeles Historic Cultural Monument #765. 
Designed by John B. Parkinson, the building was originally built in 1916 in the Beaux Arts style as Blackstone’s Department Store Building.
In 2010, the building was converted into 82 apartments with ground-floor retail space and a two-level subterranean parking garage.

Meadowglen Business Park is a versatile two-building industrial complex at 11381 and 11391 Meadowglen Lane within Houston's deed-restricted Westchase Business District. Flexible floor plan office and warehouse configurations provide dynamic space solutions for businesses requiring a polished presence with efficient back-of-house operations. Large glass storefronts deliver excellent visibility for office, retail, or showroom needs, while the rear-loading design ensures smooth logistics.
  
Equipped with grade-level roll-up doors, semi-dock high loading, and ramp access, the units offer an average clear height of 16 feet, perfect for vertical storage, staging, and equipment. Wide truck courts at the rear create seamless circulation for loading and delivery, while ample central car parking and dual access points make for convenient customer and employee entry. Users such as contractors, workshops, service-based businesses, specialty retailers, and showrooms will find this location ideal for combining customer-facing functions with operational efficiency.
  
Next to Nexus Children's Hospital and surrounded by growing residential neighborhoods, the park benefits from excellent connectivity to retail and dining options along Westheimer Road, including Kohl's, Trader Joe's, Target, Whole Foods, PF Changs, and more. The Energy Corridor District, home to the headquarters and regional offices of prominent global firms such as BP, Citgo, and McDermott International, is only minutes away. The district provides seamless access to Beltway 8, Interstate 10, US Highway 59, and the Westpark Tollway, ensuring reach across the entire Houston metro. Limited availability and a lack of new construction in the area further enhance Meadowglen Business Park as a prime choice for forward-thinking businesses.

Barnhart Interests is pleased to welcome growing businesses to discover this upscale, freestanding retail facility with a high traffic location in the Galleria/Tanglewood area at 1777 Sage Road. 
 
This expertly maintained stucco building includes a total of 1,641 square feet that was formerly used as a bank and revamped to serve as a boutique jewelry store. It is equipped with a welcoming lobby with a large service counter, several private office or retail spaces, and private restrooms. The building can also be updated to add a drive-thru, enhancing functionality for a wide range of retail ventures. 
 
1777 Sage Road enjoys a high-traffic location just down the street from the intersection with San Felipe, delivering daily traffic counts exceeding 50,000. Neighbored by a grocery-anchored retail center with popular local and national tenants, as well as a freestanding location for Bank of America, the property also sees exceptional daily foot traffic. It is well-equipped to handle the elevated traffic in the area with on-site parking with two access points, as well as pronounced signage. Providing simplified access for customers and staff from across the greater Houston region, the building is easily reachable from nearby Loop 610, as well as Interstates 10 and 69. 
 
Set in Houston’s most sought-after retail corridor, just a mile from the iconic Galleria shopping mall, this property enjoys unparalleled visibility and access. The Galleria, renowned as the county’s second-largest shopping destination, draws over 30 million visitors annually with its 400+ luxury retailers and fine dining venues, anchored by names like Macy’s, Neiman Marcus, and Saks Fifth Avenue. This constant influx of affluent shoppers provides exceptional exposure and business potential for tenants.
 
Beyond retail, the area offers proximity to premier recreational amenities such as Memorial Park and the Houston Arboretum, River Oaks Country Club, and Houston Country Club, further enhancing its appeal. Within a 2-mile radius, the vibrant local population has surged by over 10% since 2020, now exceeding 91,000 residents. The average household income sits over $121,000, generating more than $1.5 billion in annual consumer spending during 2024. For retailers seeking a best-in-class location with unmatched demographics and foot traffic, this area stands unrivaled.

Landmark Turn-Key Restaurant Opportunity next to The Broad Museum 
Former Home to the Acclaimed Otium Restaurant — Bunker Hill, Downtown Los Angeles

Step into a rare, turn-key opportunity in the heart of Downtown Los Angeles. Formerly home to the iconic Otium restaurant, this beautifully designed, high-end space seamlessly blends modern sophistication with warm, natural elements. Featuring soaring ceilings, expansive glass walls, custom architectural fixtures, and a fully built-out, world-class chef’s kitchen, the space is perfectly optimized for an elevated dining concept or an upscale, high-volume event venue.

Unrivaled Cultural & Arts District Location
Positioned directly adjacent to The Broad Museum and directly across from the Walt Disney Concert Hall, this landmark destination offers unmatched prestige, exceptional visibility, and an affluent, consistent stream of foot traffic from museum-goers, theater patrons, tourists, and DTLA professionals.

An Unprecedented Financing & Lease Structure
To secure a visionary operator capable of matching the prestige of this location, ownership is offering a revolutionary, low-risk leasing model. Rather than standard market base rent, this space is available on a pure percentage lease at 6% of monthly gross sales with favorable Net 30 payment terms. This structure ensures you preserve vital working capital to invest into launch marketing, top-tier talent, and premium inventory, sharing the upside of your success directly with the property.

Don’t miss this unparalleled opportunity to bring your culinary vision to life in one of Los Angeles’s most architecturally stunning, completely ready-to-operate flagship spaces.

Key Features:
Fully operational, high-end commercial kitchen & bar infrastructure
Dramatic indoor-outdoor architectural flow with soaring glass walls
Elite neighbors including The Broad, MOCA, and Walt Disney Concert Hall
Located in the prestigious Bunker Hill cultural corridor
6% Gross Sales lease structure (No baseline rent requirement)

Otium opened in 2015 led by Chef Timothy Hollingsworth, a James Beard and three Michelin star awarded chef. A modern American restaurant known for its vibrant, open kitchen and sleek, industrial-chic design (designed by Osvaldo Maiozzi) with a menu focused on seasonal ingredients and globally inspired flavors. This ~5,500 square foot space is now available for a new food and beverage tenant to breathe life in the space as both a museum dining experience and culinary destination in downtown LA. Lease terms include a 10-year initial term with a 5-year extension option. Rent is equal to 6% of monthly gross sales, payable Net 30.

Welcome to flexible, light industrial leasing opportunities at Houston’s Pine Forest Business Center.
    
The park features concrete tilt-wall construction, dock-high front-loading doors, semi-dock rear-loading doors, a 17 to 19-foot clear height, security lighting, and concrete paving. There are multiple points of entry per warehouse, with primary ingress/egress at the corner of Yale and E 36th Street, where more than 13,000 vehicles pass daily. 
    
The business center is ideally located outside of Downtown Houston near the Interstate 45 and Houston 610 interchange, making regional delivery logistics a breeze. The George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) is approximately 17 miles north via Hardy Toll Road, and the William P. Hobby Airport is 16 miles south via Interstate 45. 
     
Industrial properties comprise a large portion of the market's inventory, evidenced by the metro’s surge in big-box warehouse development, fueled by port expansion, strong population growth, and its strategic location. Generous state incentives, such as no corporate or personal income tax, continue to attract industry users alike. 
     
Inquire today and learn more about how the Pine Forest Business Center can support flexible business operations and logistics.
