12050 Proctor Street offers a rare opportunity to lease a freestanding 33,611-square-foot industrial facility in one of Northwest Houston's most established manufacturing and distribution corridors. Available for immediate occupancy, the property combines exceptional warehouse functionality, heavy industrial infrastructure, and outstanding regional connectivity, making it well suited for manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and other industrial operations.
 
The facility features 28,218 square feet of warehouse space complemented by 5,393 square feet of finished office space, creating an ideal balance between administrative and production functions. The warehouse is equipped with a highly desirable 40-foot clear height, eight oversized grade-level loading doors, and two 20-ton bridge cranes with a 32-foot hook height and a 248-foot crane runway—capabilities rarely available in facilities of this size.

George Bush Intercontinental Airport is approximately 15.5 miles away, providing convenient access to domestic and international air freight services.
 
For companies seeking a highly functional industrial facility with exceptional crane capacity, significant power, outdoor storage, and outstanding transportation access, 12050 Proctor Street represents a unique leasing opportunity in today's Northwest Houston market. Lease the Historic Cole's French Dip Space: A Unique LA Opportunity

A rare 5,056 sq ft opportunity is available to lease the iconic 118 E 6th Street, former home of Cole's French Dip. Established in 1908, Cole's is Los Angeles' oldest public house and continuous restaurant, famed for its claim to inventing the French Dip sandwich and its deep roots in the Pacific Electric Building. Designated a Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument, it served a diverse clientele for over a century, appearing in films and hosting figures like Charles Bukowski.

After 118 years, Cole's recently closed due to economic pressures. This marks a pivotal moment for a new business to inhabit a space with unparalleled recognition and a rich emotional connection within downtown LA. The ideal tenant will honor this profound legacy while crafting a compelling new chapter for this celebrated address, rekindling its spirit of history and hospitality.

Vibe Hobby curates a community experience by nurturing connection through communal amenities, workspaces that foster collaboration, and a superior location for people to convene and explore.
  
Comprising two buildings, Vibe Hobby is replete with advantages and unique space solutions to uplift the success of any business. The interior features an updated lobby and a large, open atrium and new gym. The spaces available range from creative and inviting coworking to collaborative open floor plan spaces to turnkey offices perfect for professional services. In its shared workspace portion, Vibe Ventures offers coworking space and executive offices where members can choose the flexible plan that fits them and enjoy helpful staff, high-end workspaces, exclusive services, and access to all of Vibe Hobby’s amenities. 
  
Vibe Hobby was renovated in 2022, improving its core facets and elevating its amenities and common areas to new heights, most prominently, the new atrium lobbies and vibrantly designed outdoor lounge. These add to Vibe’s best-in-class selection of existing amenities, including a tenant lounge, state-of-the-art conference rooms, on-site staff, gorgeous new gym, and a super-convenient deli. 
  
The buildings are located directly off Gulf Freeway and Interstate 45 within Southeast Houston. Commuters benefit from this location as the drive to Downtown Houston and Clear Lake is around 15 minutes, and Hobby Airport is a noticeably short drive away. Major business centers are close by as well, with the Port of Houston Authority reachable within a 13-minute drive and NASA Mission Control in 24 minutes. The area immediately surrounding Vibe Hobby is rich with businesses to help cover everyday needs. Personal services like dry-cleaners, fitness centers, and health care such as Luna’s Tailor and Dry-Clean, CVS, Walgreens, 24-Hour Fitness, and Concentra are all within minutes. Quick eats and full-service restaurants are nearby as well and include Wendy’s, Kelley’s Country Kitchen, and Fleming’s Prime Steakhouse and Wine Bar. Vibe Hobby offers tenants plenty of on-site amenities providing the highest quality of business environment possible.

Century Business Plaza is a versatile business environment designed to support office, warehouse, and service-oriented operations in one of Houston’s most strategically connected industrial corridors. 
  
Comprising three multi-tenant tilt-wall buildings, the plaza’s configuration is tailored to businesses that depend on both administrative and operational functions. With 16-foot clear heights, offices, private restrooms, 100% air-conditioned warehouse space, and a combination of grade-level and dock-high loading, Century Business Plaza accommodates diverse operational requirements while supporting efficient workflow and product movement. 
  
Positioned just off Interstate 45 north of Beltway 8, Century Business Plaza provides exceptional connectivity to Greater Houston and beyond. Service-based users benefit from convenient access to affluent communities, such as Spring, Conroe, and The Woodlands, while industrial and logistics operators gain efficient connections to Downtown Houston, the Houston Ship Channel, Interstate 10, Highway 290, Highway 249, and the Port of Houston’s primary truck gateway. George Bush Intercontinental Airport’s air cargo facilities are reachable within minutes, supporting regional and global distribution requirements. The strength of this transportation network has attracted prominent operators to the immediate area, including C&S Wholesale, Volume International, DHL, Majewski Transportation, and Rivian.

Central Square is an ideal location for a business looking for its slice of Houston. It is designed to seamlessly fit into the Midtown urban space and become the modern centerpiece of this rapidly developing district. The building was transformed with a beautiful glass façade and an updated amenity package suited to meet the needs of today’s businesses. 
  
Central Square features a ground-floor boutique coffee house/restaurant and an attached eight-level parking garage with valet services and visitor parking on the first level. Tenants can access a top-tier amenity package, including a tenant-only conference facility, a state-of-the-art building and energy management system, dedicated on-site management, and LEED Gold Certification. The current tenant roster presents a strong mix of architectural, finance, software, and law firms. 
  
The building is highly visible from Interstate 45, presenting signage opportunities visible to over 18,000 drivers passing daily. Midtown is home to some of Houston’s finest dining, museums, nightlife, and more than 5,000 highly desirable apartment homes. Businesses like Gyu-Kaku Japanese BBQ, Brennan’s of Houston, Midtown Arts & Theater Center Houston (MATCH), and Howl at the Moon draw locals and visitors to the neighborhood. Central Square is uniquely positioned to take advantage of all that this vibrant and still-growing neighborhood offers.

Luminary Residences offers Class A multifamily living in a 30-story Midtown high-rise where in-home comfort and neighborhood connectivity work together. Built in 2020, the property pairs controlled access, concierge service, a fitness center, pool, clubhouse, cabanas, conference rooms, guest accommodations, and on-site retail with everyday conveniences including stainless steel appliances, hardwood floors, walk-in closets, washers and dryers, balconies, and pet-friendly outdoor features such as a dog park and pet play area. The amenity package supports both daily routine and flexible work-from-home needs.

Its Main Street address places residents in one of Houston's most connected inner-loop neighborhoods. Midtown is supported by ongoing public-realm and infrastructure investment through the Midtown Redevelopment Authority and TIRZ, with improvements focused on streets, utilities, parks, sidewalks, and cultural amenities. Houston's Walkable Places planning framework identifies Midtown for pedestrian-oriented development, reflecting the district's compact block pattern and mix of uses. The METRORail Red Line runs along Main Street and connects directly to Downtown, the Texas Medical Center, the Museum District, the Houston Zoo, NRG Park, and transfer opportunities for the University of Houston and Texas Southern University. Nearby institutions such as Houston City College Central and The Ensemble Theatre strengthen the neighborhood's education and cultural base. Residents benefit from access to one of the nation's largest urban economies in a city of approximately 2.4 million people.
